description: Agent Automotive: submit a vehicle listing as presented with the vehicle record behind it: the listing with its VIN, model year, make, model, trim, mileage with its unit (miles or kilometers), the seller and the day listed; the vehicle record with the same vehicle fields, the latest odometer reading with its unit and day, and where the record comes from, such as a title, registration or service record. The signed report gives the listing and the record, the VIN, year, make, model and trim on each side read as matching or differing, and the listed mileage against the record’s reading in miles as matching, earlier, understated, unbacked or inconsistent, and counts them, and names a misstated listing: a VIN, model year, make or model listed unlike the vehicle record, a listed mileage below the record’s reading, and a listing dated before the record’s reading that shows more miles than it; then another trim and a listed mileage above the record’s reading with no reading behind it, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A VIN, year, make, model or mileage missing on either side leaves the listing unverified. VINs match by their letters and digits, makes with common short names spelled out so Chevy and Chevrolet read as one, models and trims by their letters and digits so F-150 and F150 read as one, and kilometers convert to miles; the asking price is not read. This reads a vehicle listing against the vehicle record, identified by VIN: wever_realty-listing-check reads a property listing against its property record by parcel and address, and wever_listing-check reads a product listing as submitted for missing fields, image reachability and price sanity against its own attributes, not against a vehicle record. Verdict auto_listing_misstated, auto_listing_partial, auto_listing_unverified or auto_listing_accurate. POST /api/auto-listing-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
